# Shanker Dental & Craniofacial Centre, Madurai

> A purpose-built, 7,500 sq ft dental and maxillofacial hospital in Gandhi Nagar, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. It brings oral and maxillofacial surgery, craniofacial surgery, corrective jaw surgery, facial trauma care, cleft lip and palate care, TMJ surgery, treatment of jaw cysts and tumours, orthodontics (braces and Invisalign) and dental and zygoma implants under one roof, with digital X-ray imaging, operating theatres and in-patient rooms on site. Also listed on Google as "Shankar Mohan Dental & Craniofacial Center".

- Address: 17/33 Rajaji Street, Gandhi Nagar, Madurai 625020, Tamil Nadu, India (2 minutes' walk from the Anna Bus Stand, with off-street car parking)
- Appointments: +91 91599 99362, +91 97884 73879
- Email: orthomax@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 9:30am to 1pm and 4pm to 8pm; Sunday 9:30am to 1pm
- Languages: English and Tamil (the website is available in both)
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3733348255092878235

## Consultants

- [Dr Shanker Mohan](https://dentalmadurai.com/doctors.html): MDS, AO/ASIF, FFDRCS, FDSRCS. Consultant oral and maxillofacial surgeon. Trained at the Royal London Hospital, UK, and the National Maxillofacial Unit in Dublin, Ireland; fellowships from the Royal College of Surgeons of England and Ireland.
- [Dr Aijitha Shanker](https://dentalmadurai.com/doctors.html): BDS, MDS (Orthodontia). Consultant orthodontist and certified Invisalign provider, with a special interest in facial deformity and cleft lip and palate.

## Treatments

- [Oral and maxillofacial surgery](https://dentalmadurai.com/maxillofacial-surgery.html): diseases, injuries and deformities of the mouth, jaws, face and neck.
- [Craniofacial surgery](https://dentalmadurai.com/craniofacial-surgery.html): craniosynostosis correction (trigonocephaly, plagiocephaly) by a joint neurosurgical and maxillofacial team.
- [Orthognathic (corrective jaw) surgery](https://dentalmadurai.com/orthognathic-surgery.html): Le Fort I, BSSO and genioplasty, usually done from inside the mouth with no visible scars.
- [Facial trauma surgery](https://dentalmadurai.com/facial-trauma-surgery.html): open reduction and internal fixation of jaw, cheekbone, nasal and orbital fractures.
- [Cleft lip and palate surgery](https://dentalmadurai.com/cleft-lip-and-palate-surgery.html): complete care from lip and palate repair to alveolar bone grafting, orthodontics and jaw surgery.
- [TMJ (jaw joint) surgery](https://dentalmadurai.com/tmj-surgery.html): release of TMJ ankylosis, with a difficult airway team.
- [Oral and maxillofacial pathology](https://dentalmadurai.com/oral-and-maxillofacial-pathology.html): jaw cysts and tumours, including resection and fibula free flap reconstruction.
- [Orthodontics](https://dentalmadurai.com/orthodontics.html): fixed braces, removable and functional appliances and Invisalign for children and adults.
- [Dental and facial implants](https://dentalmadurai.com/dental-and-facial-implants.html): single tooth, full mouth and zygoma implants, bone grafting and sinus lift.

## More

- [Facilities](https://dentalmadurai.com/facilities.html): digital OPG, cephalometry and RVG X-rays, integrated operating theatres, air-conditioned in-patient rooms.
- [Interesting Case of the Month](https://dentalmadurai.com/case-of-the-month.html): a monthly archive of cases treated at the centre since 2020.
